recommended_approach: Rigid Body — impact-centered Voronoi pre-fracture + breakable FIXED rigid body constraints + kinematic-to-active brick projectile, optionally augmented with small particle debris for micro-chips. This matches the documented 'Constraint-Based Glass Shattering' / 'Combined Hero Destruction' approach and is the best fit for a realistic cinematic window break.

projectile.kinematic: True during approach, switch to False at impact

warnings: Basic pre-fracture alone is less realistic for this shot; without breakable constraints, shards tend to separate/fall all at once instead of propagating from the impact.
Use higher rigid body world quality for fast glass events; low substeps/solver iterations can cause jitter or missed collisions.
Use substeps_per_frame, not steps_per_second; the pattern notes steps_per_second was removed in Blender 5.0.
For a projectile hit, keep the brick kinematic during the animated approach and switch to active at impact, otherwise the hit can miss or behave unpredictably.
CONVEX_HULL is the recommended shard collision shape here as the documented speed/accuracy balance for many small fragments.
alternative_approaches: Simpler pre-fractured rigid body swap: reveal a pre-broken glass set at impact and simulate shards without a breakable constraint network.
Manual Voronoi / geometry-nodes-inspired fracture with impact-centered point density, then convert those pieces to rigid bodies for more art direction over shard shapes.
Hybrid approach: rigid body hero shards for large pieces plus a particle debris emitter for tiny chips and secondary breakup.
